zh: 道路无权，按“最短路距离”配送就是按 BFS 层数配送；同一层内再按城市编号排序。
从工厂城市做一次 BFS 得到每个可达城市的最短边数，然后把可达城市（除起点）按（距离，编号）排序输出即可。
建无向邻接表；dist 全设为 −1，起点为 0，BFS 扩展；收集 dist≥0 且不是起点的城市，按距离升序、距离相同按编号升序排序；用空格连接输出，没有可达城市时输出空行。
en: Roads are unweighted, so delivering in order of shortest-path distance means delivering in BFS layer order, and within a layer by city number.
Run one BFS from the factory city to get every reachable city's shortest edge count, then output the reachable cities other than the start sorted by (distance, number).

Build an undirected adjacency list; set every distance to -1 and the start to 0, then BFS; collect the cities with distance >= 0 other than the start, sort by distance ascending and then by number ascending; print them space-separated, or an empty line when no other city is reachable.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Run BFS from the factory city to get the shortest edge-count distance of every reachable city, then sort them by (distance, number) for output.

## Correctness

BFS on an unweighted graph expands layer by layer, so the layer at which a node is first reached is its shortest distance. Sorting by distance and then by number matches exactly the problem's two-level ordering; filtering out the start and the unvisited nodes respectively avoids delivering twice and ignores unreachable cities.

## Complexity

Time O(n + m), space O(n + m).
